scope: Read-only public source-dtype addendum; original7-source design/test snapshot unchanged.
required_extraction_contract: Verify pinned checkpoint/config and exact gamma/gate shapes, positive epsilon and absent gate bias.
Record actual source dtype and raw tensor digest for each gamma/gate. Permit only BF16 or binary32 finite sources unless separately reviewed.
Promote public values to binary32 exactly; BF16 is a subset of binary32. Verify a source-dtype roundtrip before using the promoted array.
Bind both original public tensor bytes and promoted little-endian binary32 bytes.
Pass those native-evaluation binary32 arrays to the exact Fraction bound helper. Do not reinterpret the original bytes as binary32.
